name: Breadcrumb
description: Hierarchical navigation extracted from existing product and documentation pages, with native or framework links, explicit current-page semantics, bilingual names and blue keyboard focus.

figma.notes: Extracted from the maintained PDP, DocPage and BlogArticle implementations; no independently verified Figma component mapping.

items.description: Ordered labels with optional href and explicit current flag. Empty arrays render nothing.

locale.description: Accessible navigation name and lang. The host supplies translated labels and URLs.

size.description: PDP caption-md or docsite body-md typography.

underline.description: Preserve PDP link underlines; false matches the docsite.

renderLink.description: Optional framework link adapter. Preserve native anchor props and semantics.

focus.note: 2px blue outline with 2px offset; 4px root gutter. Default and inverse aliases remain separate from current-page semantics.

tapTarget.note: Preserve compact 24px desktop links and 44px mobile links. Pages own visibility; compact PC targets do not claim native touch minimums.

accessibility.ariaPattern: Named breadcrumb navigation; explicit aria-current=page; decorative separators hidden.
accessibility.notes: No automatic focus or inferred current page. Static parent categories do not receive aria-current. Empty paths render nothing. Long labels wrap; focus gutters remain visible. Mobile links are 44px; hosts retain existing visibility rules.

testing.rationale: Storybook checks native keyboard activation; browser coverage verifies locale, current semantics, long paths, focus geometry and existing PDP/docsite integrations.
